queries.name: raw_scan_limit
queries.query: select time, value from weather.room1 where time >= 0 order by time limit 10

queries.name: grouped_aggregate
queries.query: select avg(value) from weather.room1 where time >= 0 group by time_bucket(60, time)

queries.name: selector_tag_read
queries.query: select tag.host as host, avg(value) as avg_value from tagged.room1 where tag.host = 'web' group by tag.host
